approval_summary: Version 4, post hoc (PRESPEC.md section 21): every stage-2 run of every scope version 3's S7 check stopped is trained and scored in full under runs/shift_hosts/supplement_v4 (stage 1 reruns whole), shown and never judged. A failed S7 check there is recorded and drops nothing. S7's limits are unchanged (1e-7; 0.05 points per start).

No judged result can move: version 3's results.json is carried byte for byte (sha256 73c3f12e07fac5d0) and claims.py, export.py and every training and scoring file are version 3's bytes, checked before the start. Version 3's stopped scopes stay not judged, p = 1.

Your words (20 Oct, 06:39 and 06:40 UTC): 'dont stop experiments, let them run in full so we can work from there towards solution'; 'same with IW BCA'. Your choices (answered 11:43 UTC): a supplement after v3; its own ledger; S7 on seeds 0-4 and the 50k-step actors; S5 on a BCA setup halts until traced.

Runs: medium-expert 56 (ReBRAC and IQL in full; TD3+BC's IW with its alone and standard), medium 42 (TD3+BC and IQL in full), stage 1's 20; about 3.9 card-h / 8.8 processor-h (high 7.8 / 17.6). Rule committed 11:45 UTC (2a8a477), before v3's results were opened (11:46 UTC); see section 21.4 for what was set after.

Version 3, post hoc (section 20): a failed S7 check stops only that learner or its IW setup in that quality (claims 'not judged', p = 1 in Holm's families); chosen after version 2's stop (ReBRAC with standard BCA, 0.132 points) on your answer 'no dont give up we need a result'; no return had been read.

Version 3 ran in full (20 Oct, 05:50-11:03 UTC, no halt): S7 stopped ReBRAC, IQL and TD3+BC's IW setup on medium-expert and TD3+BC and IQL on medium; no Claim 1 or 2 passed, so the judged study ends after seeds 0-4.

Version 2, post hoc (section 19): S7's closed-loop limit is 0.05 points per start, not 0.01 (0.635 return units on the strong mix); set after version 1's stop, before any return was read; the investigation's reading 2 missed its limit by 3% and you chose to freeze anyway (P2).

If a later start exceeds 0.05 points the stop stands and S7 is never relaxed again (your decision, 19 Oct); version 3 narrowed it to a learner or its IW setup; version 4 keeps it for judgment, not for training.
12 setups per quality: TD3+BC, CQL, IQL and ReBRAC, each alone, with standard BCA and with IW BCA.
Unifloral at f2dc127, its own defaults; discount 0.98; 100,000 outer steps; JAX 0.6.2 on the card.
Data: the weighting test's logs, medium-expert and medium, gapped, data seeds 0-4 (hashes fixed).
Per quality: 60 setup runs, 20 room references, 2 sham-alone runs (TD3+BC, IQL); stage 1 first. Version 4 trains stage 1 and only the supplement's runs.
Caps: medium-expert 14 card-h / 21 processor-h (stages 1-2a); medium 12 / 16 (stage 2b). Version 4 books its own ledger under these numbers (D2).
Stage 0 (building and testing, about 4.2 card-h / 17 processor-h) is booked separately, as you chose.
Stage 3 only where Claim 1 or 2 passes, under a later version you approve, at most 4 / 6 per quality.

Stop rules S0-S11 with fixed thresholds; every stop but S7 halts the driver (version 3: S7 stops a learner or its IW setup; version 4's supplement records it and drops nothing); nothing is retried silently.
Claims 0-6, kill rules fixed now: bar +1.8 return units, one-sided 95% bounds, Holm over 4 learners.
Decisions: CQL's two programs; sham-alone for TD3+BC and IQL; NaN threshold stops, R = +inf refuses.
Decisions: IQL keeps its learner part on learner-side validity; S9 compares with this environment.
Amendments made while building are listed with reasons in PRESPEC.md section 16.
Seeds 0-4 are exploratory: no claim from them is confirmatory.
Seeds 10-14 of the weighting test's generator (master seed 20261016) are reserved for a confirmation.
Any later change to code, settings or rules needs a new version and your approval at this terminal.

data.source: the weighting test's data, spec version 5, stalling world, master seed 20261016, built by experiments/shift_iw/data.py (plan 2.1)

qualities.medium-expert: 65% of steps uniform random in half the episodes, none in the other half
qualities.medium: 65% of steps uniform random in every episode (a separate test bed, its own Holm families and cap)

data.layout: 1,000 episodes of 100 steps per seed: 0-499 train, 500-699 calibrate (5 bank rows each), 700-999 held out; 300-episode test logs under the mild and strong laws
data.gap: the densest-15% ball of commands of the same seed's expert log (experiments/truth/gap.find_gap), cut from training and bank rows only; the uncut full log serves only the room references (plan 2.2)
data.exact_iw_weight: w(c) = p_strong(c) / p_train(c) = 0.090718 e^(4c), in [e^-2, e^2] on every row

per_learner.standard: restated step with BCA, one threshold for every row; refused rows dose 1 (IQL weight 0)
per_learner.iw: the same restated step, a threshold per row from exact weights; refused rows most caution

also_run.room: each learner alone on the full log, seeds 0-4 (20 per quality); changes no verdict except an S5, which is its learner's Claim 0 failure
also_run.sham_alone: restated step with BCA present and never refreshed; seed 0, 100,000 steps; TD3+BC and IQL only, one per quality (choice 19, decision 2); reported, never judged
also_run.stage1: medium-expert, seed 0, 15,000 steps: alone, standard, iw, iw_ones (every weight 1), iw_repeat per learner (20 runs); no return read

setups.reference_row: CORL-derived TD3+BC (weighting test), read from its own records after approval; never in a claim, a Holm family or a kill rule

bca.band: q +- U around the critic's value; target the learner's own one-step error |y - q|
bca.width: U = R x u x max(eta, 1e-6)
bca.dose: 1 + 0.5 x U / (U + u), in [1, 1.5], read at the recorded (state, command) with no gradient
bca.iql_weight: w = 1 + A / (A + U) x (min(e^(3A), 100) - 1) for A > 0; Unifloral's weight elsewhere
bca.fit: once per outer step on that step's batch, Bayesian-bootstrap weights, soft coverage loss

where.td3_bc: each row's cloning error in the actor loss; fit before both critic updates (choice 13)
where.rebrac: actor_bc_coef * (sg(m) * bc_loss).mean(); doses in [1, 2]; fit as TD3+BC
where.cql: each row's conservative gap for all ten critics; fit just before the critic loss (choice 14)
where.iql: positive-advantage actor weights; fit after the target averaging (choice 15)

iw.weights: exact w(c) from the observed current; bank rows weighted, each training row a test point with its own mass
iw.grid: t = 1.01^k covering every training row's and strong-law test step's mass plus w(0.1) and w(1.1); each row rounds its mass up to the next grid point
iw.weights_of_one: grid [1.0]; must equal standard bit for bit (S2)

refused_rows.iql: weight 1 where A > 0, Unifloral's weight elsewhere

iw.last_refresh_readouts: estimated-weight table and coverage (choice 20), shuffled-weights placebo, dose change against the standard threshold; reported, never judged

scoring.rollout: float64 simulator, 100 steps; parameters cast to float64, observation rounded to float32 first; nan_to_num on the command

actions.cql: sampled tanh-Gaussian with the declared noise; tanh of the mean scored and shown

scoring.cql_noise: default_rng([20261016, 1004, bank index]) standard normals 1,000 x 100 x 4 rounded to float32, bank index in the order of banks

failure_events.F1: the episode's return is strictly below the zero-command controller's return from the same start
failure_events.F2: from state 10 on, the largest norm of the five floats' 10 position and speed numbers is strictly above the 99th percentile (numpy linear) of the same quantity for the stall-aware controller on the same bank

seeds.status: exploratory: already seen by the weighting test; no claim from them is confirmatory

bca_fit_s91_tag91.rule: default_rng([20261016, rep, 91]).integers(2**31 - 1); per-step key fold_in(PRNGKey(s91), outer step)

bca_refresh_s39_tag39.rule: default_rng([20261016, rep, 39]).integers(2**31 - 1); refresh key fold_in(PRNGKey(s39), step)

streams.coverage_target_noise_tag51: default_rng([20261016, rep, 51, 2]) (recorded steps), with one more tag 1 (actor commands) or 2 (visited states)

seeds.unifloral_key: PRNGKey(Args.seed), the file's own network split, one split after every 2,500-step chunk (its evaluation key, discarded); BCA's streams never touch it

reserved_for_confirmation.rule: nothing in this study creates, reads or trains on them; a confirmation of a passing claim uses them under a pre-registration that keeps these pass marks, approved at the user's terminal

decisions.what: CQL's BCA runs use two compiled programs: Unifloral's pre-refresh program (dose_active=False) until outer step 10,000, then the dose-active program
decisions.why: the single program drifts 1.55e-4 relative on the card at a dose of exactly 1 (test (a2) allows 1e-6); before the first refresh every dose is exactly 1

decisions.what: choice 19 follows the plan's letter: TD3+BC and IQL recorded card rounding differences in test (a2), so S10 is a readout for them and each quality gets a seed-0 sham-alone run for each; CQL and ReBRAC no
decisions.why: TD3+BC: state and key bit for bit, logged losses within 8.0e-8 relative; IQL: every leaf within 3.8e-7 relative; CQL (two programs) and ReBRAC bit for bit

decisions.what: S5: a NaN threshold stops; R = +inf is a counted refusal ('cannot certify'), not a stop
decisions.why: plan 4.1 defines R = +inf as cannot certify, with refused rows counted

decisions.what: IQL keeps the learner part of its carry on learner-side validity (its Decision 1)
decisions.why: selecting the whole carry on a flag that depends on the band fit changed Unifloral's compiled arithmetic (test (a2) failed on the processor); the flag still stops the run (S5)

decisions.what: the S9 signature is the final environment's (environment.s9_signature)
decisions.why: taken from the final stage-0 suite's card process; equal in all 58 card records of stage 0

stop_rules.meaning: any stop but S7 halts the driver: nothing new launches, running children finish, driver/STOP.json and STOP.txt are written; nothing is retried silently; S5 on alone or room is that learner's Claim 0 outcome and the driver goes on; S5 on a BCA setup halts until traced; any change after approval needs a new version approved at the terminal; S7 (version 3, post hoc): a failed check stops its learner (alone, standard, iw_ones actor) or only its IW setup (iw, iw_repeat actor) in that quality, its later runs in that quality never train and its runs are never used, and the driver goes on; an S7 result that does not verify halts; version 4 (post hoc, PRESPEC.md section 21): in the supplement every run of a scope version 3's S7 stopped trains and is scored, shown and never judged, and a failed S7 check is recorded and drops nothing; every other stop halts as before (S5 on a BCA setup until traced)

definitions.bit_for_bit: equal tobytes() of every leaf of learner state, optimizer states, key carry and per-step outputs

S0.rule: any of tests (a1)-(i) or the guard's comparison fails
S0.when: before stage 1, on the frozen bytes

S1.rule: at the start of any run: an imported Unifloral file differs from configs/unifloral.json, or the fingerprint (SHA-256 of prespec.json's SHA-256 and the code manifest) differs from the approved one, or the approval is not committed under the user's address

S2.rule: for any learner, iw_ones differs from standard in any bit after the refresh (final key, learner state, BCA state but the carried refusal rule, per-step outputs), or R(1) differs from the stored standard threshold in float32

S3.rule: at any IW refresh, bank scores recomputed from the stored state with the refresh key fail to reproduce the stored standard threshold bit for bit

S4.rule: a learner's setups differ in initial-parameter hashes (room included), or alone, standard and IW differ in the hash of Unifloral's key carried out of a chunk
S4.when: after stage 1, after every seed, after the room block

S5.rule: any non-finite loss, metric, parameter, dose, weight or return; a NaN threshold; a dose outside its bounds; any false per-step validity flag; a refresh failing BCA's validity checks

S6.rule: after stage 1: the projection of stages 1-2 of a quality (totals so far plus projected) above its cap, or a learner alone's stage-1 ms per outer step more than twice its reference (at two at once, scaled by the measured slowdown); during stage 2: an alone run more than twice its stage-1 time per outer step

two_at_once.measured_on: stage 1's iw alone against iw_ones and iw_repeat together, outer steps per wall-clock second, the four learners together

S6.steady_speed: median over chunks 2 onward of chunk time less JAX's reported compile time

S6b.rule: before each unit (sham-alone block, each seed, room block): running totals plus queued scoring work plus the unit's projected cost would pass the quality's cap; stop between whole units
S6b.card_hour: one hour of wall-clock time with at least one card run active (union of intervals, monotonic clock)
S6b.processor_hour: one hour of measured user plus system processor time, summed over all processes

S7.rule: open loop, by file: the float32 restatement (actors_f32.py) and the learner's own float32 network disagree by more than 1e-7 on any saved state; closed loop: that restatement and the float64 scoring adapter disagree by more than 0.05 points on any start
S7.changed: version 2, post hoc (PRESPEC.md section 19; post_hoc_changes P1)
S7.on: every stage-1 actor and every seed-0 final actor of alone, standard and IW; version 4 (PRESPEC.md section 21): in the supplement also the 100,000-step and 50,000-step actors of every planned alone, standard and IW run at seeds 0-4 (prespec supplement.s7; the owner's decision D3); only stage 1's and seed 0's final actors write check keys
S7.on_failure: version 3: stops a scope in that quality, not the driver: the learner for an alone, standard or iw_ones actor; that learner's IW setup for an iw or iw_repeat actor (stages.S7_SCOPE); stage 1 always runs whole; a result that does not verify halts; version 4 (supplement): recorded in state.json s7_stopped (with its scope, the actor's step and version 4) and every lane's verdict in s7_results; no run or lane is dropped and nothing halts for it; the scope stays not judged with p = 1 (version 3's judgment, carried); a result that does not verify, or disagrees with its lane's exit status, halts
S7.on_failure_changed: version 3, post hoc (PRESPEC.md section 20; post_hoc_changes P3); versions 1 and 2: any failure halted the driver; version 4, post hoc (PRESPEC.md section 21; post_hoc_changes P4)

S8.rule: the two identical 15,000-step IW runs of a learner (stage 1, seed 0) differ in any bit: final key, learner state, BCA state, per-step outputs, any refresh's threshold

S9.rule: a card run's stages.env_signature differs from environment.s9_signature in any key

S10.rule: at outer step 10,000 a BCA setup's learner state or key differs in any bit from its learner alone's (stage 1, seed 0)

S11.rule: a copied weighting-test file's SHA-256 differs from its manifest, or a prepared array's row counts or recorded hashes differ from the weighting test's
S11.when: at the copy, at preparation, when a run reads its prepared file

claims.judged: per quality, on data seeds 0-4, on the strong-mix bank unless stated; final snapshot (100,000)

0.title: The learner learned (a gate for reading its BCA rows)
0.kill: the learner alone's mean no-shift return over the 5 seeds is below the bar, or any seed's return of the learner alone is not finite, or a run of Unifloral's unchanged step (alone or room reference) stopped (S5); exactly at the bar passes
0.conversion: points to return units through the no-shift bank's anchors in start_banks.json (the code uses the file's exact values)
0.then: rows read 'did not learn'; Claims 1-6 not judged; stays in both Holm families with p = 1

1.title: Standard BCA beats the learner alone on the strong mix
1.kill: Delta(standard - alone) < +1.8, or L <= 0, or it fails Holm across the four learners
1.label: a TD3+BC pass on medium-expert: 'expected partly by selection; needs seeds 10-14'

1c.title: Standard BCA costs return on the strong mix (a flag)

2.title: IW BCA beats standard BCA on the strong mix
2.kill: Delta(IW - standard) < +1.8, or L <= 0, or it fails Holm, or Claim 4a fails for that learner

2c.title: IW costs return against standard on the strong mix (a flag)

3.title: IW costs nothing without the shift (a flag)
3.flag: on the no-shift bank, Delta(IW - standard) <= -1.8 with upper bound < 0

3b.title: Standard BCA costs nothing without the shift (a flag)
3b.flag: on the no-shift bank, Delta(standard - alone) <= -1.8 with upper bound < 0

4a.title: IW gives the band its promised coverage under the shift (read before Claim 2)
4a.kill: at the IW setup's last refresh, on strong-law test steps outside the ball, each step at its own threshold, pooled coverage (mean of the 5 seeds' shares) outside [0.89, 0.96]

4b.title: The shift breaks the standard band (a label, not a gate)
4b.kill: the IW setup's band at its standard threshold covers 0.88 or more of the same steps; Claim 2 is still judged, but a pass is labeled 'gain from extra width, not repaired calibration'

5.title: BCA adds no physical failures
5.flag: a BCA setup's F1 or F2 rate exceeds its learner alone's by 2 percentage points or more on any of the 7 banks (compared exactly on start counts), with L > 0

6.title: The gain needs the band's placement, not just more caution (stage 3, only where Claim 1 or 2 passes)
6.kill: Delta(setup - its flattened twin) < +1.8 or L <= 0; for Claim 2 also Delta(IW - shuffled IW) < +1.8 or L <= 0; the gain is then credited to the amount of caution

holm_membership: every learner stays in each family of its quality; a learner that fails Claim 0, has a non-finite return in either setup compared on any seed, or (Claim 2 only) fails Claim 4a or was stopped by S7 in that quality (version 3: a stopped learner in both families, a stopped IW setup in Claim 2's only) enters with p = 1

Claims 1 and 2 are judged only when all 5 seeds of all four learners (alone, standard, IW) of the quality are complete, else 'pending'; every other claim waits for the 5 seeds of its own inputs; a setup stopped by S7 (version 3) counts as complete, with p = 1, and its runs are never used in a claim (version 4, PRESPEC.md section 21: they are trained, scored and shown in the supplement, labeled, and still enter none)
runs go seed by seed across learners, so a stop leaves complete seeds; no seed is ever dropped
claims.claim2_pointer: mean dose change from standard to IW thresholds over kept training rows at the last refresh, times Delta(standard - alone) / (mean standard dose - 1); IQL with its actor weights; never a gate
claims.study_rule: if Claims 1 and 2 are shelved for all four learners on every quality run (a learner stopped by S7 counts as shelved here), the study ends after seeds 0-4, with no stage 3 and no confirmation
claims.writeups: every shelved claim and every 'did not learn': The idea / What we tested (and the kill rule) / What happened / Why

statistics.per_seed: a setup's mean return over a bank's 1,000 starts (return units: the plain 100-step return)
statistics.delta: paired per-seed difference of two setups of one learner, averaged over the 5 seeds; sd with n - 1
statistics.bounds: one-sided 95%: mean -+ T95 x sd / sqrt(5)
statistics.p_value: one-sided P(T4 >= mean / (sd / sqrt(5))); sd = 0: p = 0 if mean > 0, else 1

holm.family: the four learners, per claim (1 and 2), per quality
holm.adjusted_p: running maximum of min(1, (4 - i + 1) p)

statistics.no_partial_statistics: no mean, bound or p-value until exactly 5 finite seeds exist
